title: Configure your node
description: Declare a speed parameter and use its value in a timer-driven controller. A parameter belongs to one node.
steps: Declare speed = 0.2.
Read it inside a timer, clamp to 0–0.8, and publish /cmd_vel.
Inspect ros2 param list and ros2 param get /student_controller speed.
hints: A timer keeps the robot receiving commands.
